title: ROSMonitoring in Action: Runtime Monitoring and Enforcement for ROS 2 Actions
abstract: arXiv:2611.22407v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Robotic applications often rely on long-running operations, such as navigation, manipulation, and inspection, which in ROS~2 are commonly implemented as actions. Unlike topics and services, actions involve a structured lifecycle comprising goal submission and acceptance, feedback, status updates, result retrieval, and cancellation. Existing versions of ROSMonitoring support topics and services, but do not reconstruct this lifecycle or expose action-level events to a runtime-verification oracle. In this paper, we extend ROSMonitoring with runtime monitoring and enforcement for ROS~2 actions. Actions are declared directly in the monitoring configuration and automatically instrumented through the underlying ROS~2 communication endpoints. The generated monitor reconstructs action-level events, correlates them through goal identifiers, maintains the state of active goals, and translates violations into protocol-aware enforcement operations. translated_title: ROSMonitoring 实战：ROS 2 动作的运行时监控与强制执行
translated_abstract: 机器人应用通常依赖于长时间运行的操作，如导航、操纵和巡检，这些操作在 ROS 2 中通常以动作的形式实现。与话题和服务不同，动作包含一个结构化的生命周期，涵盖目标提交与接受、反馈、状态更新、结果获取和取消等环节。现有版本的 ROSMonitoring 支持话题和服务，但无法重构这一生命周期，也无法将动作级别的事件暴露给运行时验证的判定器。本文对 ROSMonitoring 进行了扩展，为其增加了针对 ROS 2 动作的运行时监控与强制执行能力。动作可直接在监控配置中声明，并通过底层 ROS 2 通信端点自动进行插桩。生成的监视器能够重构动作级别的事件，通过目标标识符将事件关联起来，维护活跃目标的状态，并将违规行为转化为协议感知的强制执行操作。
tldr: 本文扩展了 ROSMonitoring 框架，首次实现了对 ROS 2 动作这一通信原语的运行时监控与强制执行，通过重构动作生命周期、基于目标标识符关联事件，并将违规行为转化为协议感知的执行操作。
en_tdlr: This paper extends ROSMonitoring to enable runtime monitoring and enforcement for ROS 2 actions, reconstructing the structured action lifecycle, correlating events via goal identifiers, and translating violations into protocol-aware enforcement operations.
